#### Stage9A.3 — bounded VAB calibration and Qwen3 validity stop

**Completed at the plan's mandatory Qwen3 baseline-validity stop.** Qwen2.5-VL-3B CoT recovered a finite direct-access regime. Qwen3-VL-2B failed its FULL-access accuracy and CoT gates, so its masked grid was not run and the generation comparison is underidentified. No Thinking experiment, further reserve, prompt search, or next research action was launched. All GPUs are released.

The approved question was whether the finite direct-image-access regime in Qwen2.5 CoT transfers to Qwen3 CoT under the same bounded assay. The [approved plan](<../plan/stage9a3_bounded_vab_calibration_qwen25_vs_qwen3_cot_plan.md>) and [frozen execution protocol](<../plan/stage9a3_execution_protocol_v1.md>) govern this run. The controlled counting setup follows the [VAB paper's task description](https://arxiv.org/html/2607.12815v2); this is a bounded reimplementation, not an exact published-boundary reproduction.

The corpus contains32 primary images,16 prospectively frozen reserve images and4 disjoint technical images. Each image has one color and one shape query. Prompts/options, greedy decoding, BF16 weights, preprocessing limits, seeds and model revisions were frozen. Every decoder layer participates in the depth/time rectangle; prefill, image K/V and previously propagated image information remain intact. The grid is depth fractions0/.5/.75/1 × token cutoffs0/16/64/FULL. Both models passed all eight actual-model technical checks, including exact no-op logits/tokens, zero blocked probabilities, preserved prefill and cached continuation.

| FULL cohort | Correct | Intermediate reasoning | Valid option / normal EOS | Capped |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Qwen2.5 primary,32 images |47/64 (73.44%)|62/64 (96.88%)|64/64|0|
| Qwen2.5 reserve,16 images |21/32 (65.63%)|32/32|31/32|1|
| Qwen2.5 combined,48 images |68/96 (70.83%)|94/96 (97.92%)|95/96|1|
| Qwen3 primary,32 images |20/64 (31.25%)|56/64 (87.50%)|46/64|18|

All160 FULL texts were reviewed without answer keys before review seals and grading. Literal format repairs preserve the emitted option even when the model's prose count disagrees. Capped/missing answers receive no credit; no item was discarded. The mandatory initial baseline gates were evaluated on the original64 primary trajectories. The reserve's one capped FULL trajectory remains in the48-image analysis.

The32-image Qwen2.5 grid gave clear zero-access damage, but the frozen tie rule selected(0.75L,64), whose4.69pp point damage had wide uncertainty and only56.13% joint bootstrap stability. The predeclared16-image precision extension therefore activated. Its unchanged grid resolved the selection to **all decoder layers through token64**. No cutoff, prompt, cap or image selection changed.

| Qwen2.5 condition,48 images | Accuracy | Damage vs FULL |95% image-bootstrap interval for damage |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| FULL |70.83%|0|reference|
| Zero generated-query access |48.96%|21.88pp|11.46 to32.29pp|
| All layers through token16 |54.17%|16.67pp|8.33 to25.00pp|
|75% of layers through token64 |60.42%|10.42pp|1.04 to19.79pp|
| **All layers through token64** |**71.88%**|**−1.04pp**|**−5.21 to3.13pp**|

The selected condition passes the5pp preservation tolerance with **99.35% joint bootstrap stability**, together with positive zero-access damage. Raw strict-format extraction also passes, selects the same cutoff, and gives94.93% joint stability. This supports coarse finite access; it does not locate an exact token boundary or imply that visual information is erased after64. The selected mask is actually reached in92/96 native trajectories; the other four are exact identity reuses.

Inference uses equal image weighting and4,000 paired image-cluster bootstrap draws with seed920260927. Queries, cells and tokens are not independent samples. The full16-cell surface is preserved in the parquet files;32-image and48-image results remain separately accessible.

The bounded null-sink control used the primary32 images and only FULL, zero access and the selected all-layer/token64 condition.125 new continuations were needed;67 exact identities were reused. Without redistributing removed image probability onto other keys, zero-access damage remains **15.63pp [4.69,26.56]**, while token64 damage is **−1.56pp [−7.81,3.13]**. The qualitative calibration pattern survives this bounded alternative intervention.

Qwen3 fails the60% accuracy floor,90% CoT requirement and extraction/completion gates under the frozen assay. Eight outputs contain only an option;18 reach the256-token cap without a final answer. Even granting every unscorable output a correct answer yields only38/64=59.38%, below the floor. This bound holds the46 completed answers fixed and is not an imputed score. Visual/count errors, repetition and censoring are observed; their underlying cause is not established.

One consequential limitation is explicit: the frozen protocol made Qwen3 inherit Qwen2.5's256-token cap. Qwen3's technical maximum was235 tokens; applying its own1.5× length rule would have suggested512. That alternative was not run. The observed validity failure therefore belongs to this frozen prompt/task/decoding setup, and no Qwen model-generation, architecture or Thinking-specialization claim follows. No Qwen3 masked science or null-sink experiment was launched after the failed gate. Its coarse-grid parquet is an explicitly marked **empty schema artifact**, not a zero-effect result; comparison fields are null.

The initial Qwen2.5 technical validator incorrectly required eight naturally generated tokens. The repair extended only the teacher-forced cache probe and respected native EOS; all eight examples were revalidated in a new namespace. The failed receipt, six completed initial checks and original source remain preserved.26 focused CPU tests passed during implementation. Seven independent final audit groups passed, including a separate numerical reconstruction of the48-image bootstrap, all input/source/output hashes, and the mandatory stop. See [final validation](<../outputs/stage9a3/v1/audit/final_validation.json>).

Compute totaled approximately **1.88 GPU-hours**, including **1.81 GPU-hours for Phase A**, well below25. There were1,143 scientific generations: Qwen2.5 FULL96 + primary masked571 + reserve masked287 + null-sink125, and Qwen3 FULL64. Up to four GPUs ran concurrently through the project scheduler on authorized nodes; no tmux or keepalive was used. Accounting combines captured Slurm runtimes with documented submission-to-receipt estimates where completed jobs had purged. Scientific generation time itself was1.58 GPU-hours. Both checkpoints were local; no download or package installation was needed.

The previous MathVision main report and all74 completed controls remain byte-identical. Its13 unfinished controls were cancelled at safe boundaries under this plan's§27; no prior result was reinterpreted.

Figures are available as PNG/PDF: [intervention](<../outputs/stage9a3/v1/figures/figure1_intervention_rectangle.pdf>), [primary surface](<../outputs/stage9a3/v1/figures/figure2_qwen25_surface.pdf>), [48-image surface](<../outputs/stage9a3/v1/figures/figure2b_qwen25_extended_surface.pdf>), and [Qwen3 validity stop](<../outputs/stage9a3/v1/figures/figure3_qwen3_validity_stop.pdf>). A Qwen3 transfer surface and same-cutoff effect figure are not estimable. The [artifact index](<../outputs/stage9a3/v1/stage9a3_artifact_index.json>) distinguishes completed, conditional and unmeasured outputs.

**Exactly one recommendation:** obtain a separately approved bounded repair and validation of the Qwen3 FULL-access baseline before drawing a generation-level visual-access conclusion. **STOP; this recommendation has not been executed.**

provide finite-access context; Stage9A.5's null-sink control failed preservation.

replication. Conclusions are intervention-specific. The full V_A→T₁→V_B→T₂→V_A
cycle is an integration framework, not a newly measured recurrent cycle here.

The supported claim is a **population-level functional shift in successful,
controlled counting trajectories under the tested access mask and token budget**.

result. Neither demonstrates that all image information vanished or that textual
reasoning is the unique downstream carrier. Annotation is single main-agent manual
source/text review, not independent human inter-rater validation.

##### Measurement and interpretation limits

C1 means that a visual fact/subgoal is semantically resolved in the trace; it does not certify factual correctness or visual causation. C2 permits a distinct derived conclusion even when shorter than24 tokens. Requiring at least24 tokens from the end of the A quote to B onset descriptively leaves 24 clean trajectories and 34 semantic-positive trajectories. This raw anchor-gap sensitivity is not a pure text-interval duration estimate or replacement primary rule. Completion and length-quartile results, target types and dataset strata are included in the inference JSON.

C5 requires at least two consecutive target-selective measurements (target/control patch-mean ratio≥1.5 and within-image target mass≥.05), plus frozen detector positivity or an explicit B observation within32 tokens. These prospective screening thresholds are not a validated causal classifier. Detector positivity alone and raw global image attention do not qualify. Historical MathVision routing uses unchanged layers19–22 and the frozen Stage8A detector. MathVerse historical event summaries do not supply arbitrary new-B patch routing. Passive repair was used for 14 trajectories; it teacher-forced frozen prefixes with64-token eager chunks and checked observer/no-op feature/logit/cache behavior. Original native per-query routing for those traces was not saved, so reconstruction is explicitly distinguished from historical observation.

A low yield can reflect task distribution, already-textualized evidence, continuous inspection, model behavior, operational annotation limits or routing identifiability. It is not proof that recurrent perceptual demand is impossible. Stage10AR single-transition evidence and Stage4A source retargeting remain separate findings.

New GPU allocation: **0.0167 GPU-hours**; 14/32 maximum passive-repair trajectories. New generations:0. Causal interventions:0. All Stage10B GPU jobs are terminal. Annotation burden: 448 independent reviewer–trajectory judgments plus main adjudication; human labor hours were not measured.

All11 required artifacts are present in this directory; optional passive-repair data are included only when executed. Four standalone PNG/PDF figures are under `figures/`. Raw passes, semantic seals, routing evidence, provenance checks and resource receipts are under `audit/` and `annotations/`.

#### Stage10C — causal visual reopening

**Outcome D; full causal reopening + source-specificity gate: False.**

##### Design and validity

16 independent natural problem/image trajectories were tested. The original16-case primary split contains8 MathVision and8 MathVerse cases; reserve executed: False. Selection reused the exact24-event Stage10B anchor-gap sensitivity; no native-correctness or intervention-effect selection. All gold B facts, matched equal-count controls and scoring rules were sealed before interventions. Exactly three fixed reserve-compatible technical cases passed all10 checks.

The model is pinned Qwen3-VL-2B-Thinking, BF16/TF32-off, eager language/SDPA vision, native preprocessing. Historical traces were sampled; the local Stage10C branches are greedy. Fresh unmasked greedy baselines were therefore generated, and no-op equality was checked against the corresponding unmasked greedy path, not against sampled historical suffixes. All branches share the original teacher-forced native prefix. PRE masks predict tokens[B−24,B); POST masks predict[B,B+24). All28 decoder layers use the previously validated standard image-key operator, with access restored at the24-token boundary. Earlier image-derived cache remains intact.

The behavioral endpoint scores the first atomic source-local B assertion represented by the frozen native evidence span in the64-token window[B,B+64). It does not require complete solution of a broad inventory or final benchmark answer. The broader B demand and complete native evidence span remain in the gold artifact. Scores were assigned from condition-blinded local text and frozen image-grounded rules; no independent human-rater claim is made. Teacher forcing measures mean NLL of the entire native B-evidence span, including wrong native assertions and spans extending beyond64 tokens. Thus NLL measures support for the native assertion and is interpreted with correctness strata.

##### Primary paired endpoints

Equal trajectory weighting;4,000 paired bootstrap draws, seed920260927. Behavioral units are proportion differences; mechanistic units are nats/token. Adjusted intervals are98.75% marginal percentile intervals (Bonferroni family-wise95% across four endpoints).

##### Interpretation and limits

Neither robust component passes. Do not promote causal reopening from this tested candidate cohort.

Read the endpoints separately: a positive native-span NLL effect indicates reduced support for the frozen native text, not necessarily loss of a correct local visual read. The dataset and faithful-stratum tables determine whether the behavioral evidence converges with that effect. The fresh unmasked greedy continuation resolves B correctly in 3/16 cases, whereas 8/16 original sampled native spans were source-faithful. This limited behavioral resolution under the fixed window constrains the interpretation of a failed gate; it is not evidence that causal reopening is impossible.

The result applies to this selected natural candidate cohort, model, fixed local budget and intervention. PRE is a reviewed terminal text suffix; the original paragraph annotations are coarse, and semantic reasoning status is not an independently established low-necessity state. Prior image-derived state and redundant pathways remain available. A null does not establish mechanism impossibility or diagnose its cause. No full A→B→A return cycle or universal alternation is tested. Stage10AR controlled4B transition, Stage4A source retargeting and Stage10B natural passive census remain separately supported evidence.

Reserve executed: False. Demand-swap executed: False. Conditional decisions: All four aggregate points are positive, but MathVerse behavioral reopening/source effects are negative, historically faithful behavioral specificity is zero, and one/pair deletion does not retain positive behavioral directions. This is directionally inconsistent across required checks, not a precision-only shortfall. Frozen reserve gate fails. Demand-swap and null-sink controls are ineligible. Preserve positive P2 NLL evidence, stop without new anchors, windows, models or trajectories.. No post-null anchor/window or model search.

Allocated GPU-hours: **0.1208**; peak simultaneous GPUs:2; all GPU jobs terminal. Accounting includes validation/startup/failures. No new benchmark-scale generation, download or tmux allocation. ##### Exactly one recommendation

Stop the reopening branch and finalize the paper around the already-established visual-to-text transition plus dynamic source retargeting as a separate causal phenomenon.

#### Stage11A — Visual-evidence bottleneck census

Decision: **NO_GO**. Eligible evidence sets: 61/128 (47.7%; 95% CI 39.1–56.2%). The primary Thinking-correct / CoT-failed subset contains 12 independently matched families; 4 have a unique nonmixed localization.

This is a descriptive census of explicit-demand evidence recovery and observable native text. It does not establish why Thinking succeeds or identify hidden-state encoding. All128 original families and384 native trajectories were preserved.

##### Design and review

Two independent model-agent passes inspected all128 image/question packets before mode correctness was opened. A common evidence proposal received two sufficiency checks; corrections and exclusions were resolved prospectively. Only1–4 image-derived facts sufficient with the original question were eligible. The original proposal, raw reviews and repair history remain available.

Eligibility counts: `{'NO_VISUAL_BOTTLENECK': 33, 'E_STAR_ELIGIBLE': 61, 'E_STAR_TOO_LARGE': 32, 'E_STAR_AMBIGUOUS': 1, 'ANNOTATION_UNRESOLVED': 1}`. All eligible native trajectories were annotated. Explicit probes cover 61 families ×3 modes, capped at512 new tokens. The same image, semantic request, item seed, preprocessing and Stage9A mode templates were used with the pinned Qwen3-VL-2B BF16 checkpoints. No benchmark baselines were regenerated.

Native annotation saw one anonymized reasoning trace at a time, with final correctness, other modes and probe output withheld. Writing style can reveal the mode, and prior reviewer project exposure cannot be erased. Probe annotations were sealed before joining the existing reviewed native answer labels. These are independent model-agent passes, not independent human reliability measurements. A versioned workload amendment assigned 101/103/75 reviews to the two independent reviewers and main reviewer while preserving all 96 shared agreement reviews. Historical assignments and raw reviews remain unchanged.

##### Primary endpoints

| Mode | Explicit probe: all facts | Native text: sufficient facts | Native final correct | Failure given sufficient native facts |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| instruct_direct | 18/61 (29.5%; 95% CI 18.0–41.0%) | 10/61 (16.4%; 95% CI 8.2–26.2%) | 14/61 (23.0%; 95% CI 13.1–34.4%) | 4/10 (40.0%; 95% CI 10.0–70.0%) |

| thinking | 16/61 (26.2%; 95% CI 16.4–37.7%) | 13/61 (21.3%; 95% CI 11.5–31.2%) | 25/61 (41.0%; 95% CI 29.5–52.5%) | 1/13 (7.7%; 95% CI 0.0–23.1%) |

Probe rates use only probed eligible families; native rates use all eligible families. Figure2 and the matched-subset inference use the same probed-family denominator for all three measurements. #### Stage11C — completed with prescribed technical STOP

Stage11C could not localize the Thinking-versus-Instruct advantage. The common 8,192-token primary completion gate failed before the oracle. This is a completion-limited result, not evidence for a zero native gap or an upstream/downstream mechanism. Noncompletion cause remains unknown.

##### Frozen design and source evidence

The development rule used levels 2–4 across all subjects: 47 eligible earlier families (Thinking 19/47; Direct 11/47), with no fallback. The original 300-source manifest, original reviews, and source-only alias exclusions 1887/814 are preserved. No heldout outcomes selected sources or repaired E*.

We reviewed 250 source entries twice and retained 120 eligible families. Frozen split: 80 primary and 40 reserve, plus subset IDs for 24 neutral, 48 CoT, and 32 native-state families. E* and all subsets were frozen before primary inference. No reserve opened.

Two AI agents reviewed the evidence independently; these agreement measurements are not human inter-rater reliability. Each reviewer constructed a disjoint portion before reviewing the common proposals. In the final single-source batches, only reviewer A constructed proposals; reviewer B reviewed them without construction exposure. Raw all-proposal sufficiency agreement 98.0%,kappa 0.960; nonempty-proposal agreement 96.2%,kappa 0.278. Nonempty quality-conjunction agreement 93.1%,kappa 0.161. Low conditional kappa under strongly positive prevalence and all disputes remain disclosed; strict dual-pass eligibility excludes disagreements. No post-outcome evidence repair.

##### Execution and stop

Calibration: 12 non-primary cases × 2 modes × 2 caps = 48 exact valid calls. Thinking hit the cap on 12/12 and Direct on 11/12 cases at both 4,096 and 8,192 tokens. The plan therefore selected 8,192 and marked the stage completion-limited. Batch size 1, BF16, TF32 off, greedy decoding, repetition penalty 1, native image preprocessing, and pinned model revisions were preserved.

The fixed first 16 matched primary families produced 32 valid calls. The prespecified criterion stops further native/oracle work if either mode has more than 4 cap hits.

VLMEvalKit commit88ba5e79daf1a4be1b9df748a593adfc903a6557 config selects vLLM, use_custom_prompt=False for2B Instruct/Thinking. Instruct sampling/presence matches Qwen but max_new_tokens16384 differs; Thinking1/.95/20/presence0/40960 matches. The generic Qwen prompt mixin can add concise-answer instructions when enabled, but these named presets disable it. MathVision inherits the base dataset prompt using its already-formatted TSV question. HF generation path does not pass presence_penalty, unlike its vLLM path.

lmms-eval commitc59eb48ee9e5bfdf2bfd6ad97fa1aba5c9eef18f standard MathVision task uses max_new_tokens16384. Its utility prepends a step-by-step/boxed-answer instruction and serializes choices differently; the simple Qwen3-VL adapter defaults to a helpful-assistant system message and greedy generation, accepts sampling overrides but does not forward presence/repetition penalties in its generation whitelist. These are not the canonical Qwen MathVision Direct recipe. No generic framework configuration replaces the official scripts.

##### C–E. Prospective validation and decision

Use exactly original12 nonprimary IDs in their frozen order, both model variants, canonical TSV prompt and image loader, and model-specific official settings. Final technical metrics will be in qwen3vl_official_sanity_summary.md. Gate unchanged: Instruct finals>=10/12,caps<=1/12,pathologies<=1/12; incomplete/runtime-unfaithful reproduction is UNRESOLVED. Do not interpret cap hits as incorrect. No correctness evaluation is necessary.

If Instruct passes, run only the prospectively declared no_presence, thinking_sampling and long_budget variants on the same12, resources permitting; use completion/repetition only. The sampling variant changes temperature and top-p as one historical bundle, so it cannot isolate them individually. If all baseline outputs end below32768, increasing only cap cannot affect their prefixes; record this limit. Do not add a prompt ablation or another candidate after outcomes.

Established now: both prompt and runtime/decoding differ from Qwen benchmark code; the historical recipe applied Thinking-like settings to Instruct and lacked its presence penalty. Cause of severe looping remains unresolved until bounded evidence. A favorable sanity result validates the official operating regime, not a unique cause.

**Fair native comparison does not require identical decoding hyperparameters. Each variant should use its validated intended evaluation recipe. An eventual oracle can equalize evidence content while retaining model-appropriate decoding.** No scientific rerun is authorized here.

##### A. What Qwen officially does

##### D. Supported explanation

Established: the prior Direct prompt and generation/runtime configuration were not faithful to the benchmark-specific Qwen recipe. Stage11C-R reproduced the historical project configuration, not the official operating regime.


Conditional single-factor ablations were not run because the official Instruct completion gate did not pass. The official recipe therefore does not establish a remedy on this fixed set. Missing presence penalty remains a historical protocol discrepancy, not an established explanation of the loops. Prompt, model behavior and numerical/runtime interactions remain unresolved; no further tuning or protocol search was performed.

Instruct severe-loop case IDs: 1146, 1476, 409, 1563, 2214. Terminal and fixed midpoint passages plus whole-token repetition descriptors support these labels. The completed outputs can still contain redundant self-correction; the severe-pathology count is not a count of every repeated phrase.

Output format: the seven normally stopped Direct responses contain terminal boxed answers or an explicit final-answer line; all12 Thinking responses close the think section and provide a terminal boxed answer. Direct is unprompted for CoT, not constrained to answer-only text.

Runtime inspection found no concrete mismatch explaining the remaining loops: frozen canonical inputs match, official SamplingParams include the requested presence penalty with EOS enabled, both jobs exit0, and capped outputs reach the exact official cap. The original unpublished package/model revisions and hardware are not specified by Qwen, so residual numerical/runtime effects cannot be excluded. See audit/runtime_faithfulness_review.json.

Historical Stage11C-R Direct had8/12 finals and4/12 caps/loops; official Direct here has7/12 finals and5/12 caps/loops. These are different stochastic/runtime/input configurations, so this comparison does not establish that the official recipe causally worsens behavior.

##### E. Scientific rerun decision

Unchanged Instruct gate: at least10/12 committed finals, at most1/12 cap hit, at most1/12 repetition pathology. Result: **OFFICIAL_PROTOCOL_STILL_INVALID**.

Fair comparison means each model variant operates under its validated intended evaluation recipe; it does not require identical decoding settings. A later Equal-Evidence Oracle may share evidence content while preserving model-appropriate decoding. No80-family primary rerun, oracle, CoT generation, reserve or new benchmark was launched.

Allocated compute: **0.571111 GPU-hours**, including startup and any failed attempts; hard3 respected. All stage allocations released. Environment installation and source audit used CPU only.

Limitations:12 fixed cases, one sampled run per condition, execution-agent completion review, canonical JPEG serialization differs slightly from historical exports, and the official repository does not pin its original model/package revisions. Exact installed versions, source commits, model hashes, input hashes and job receipts are retained.

Runtime validation: vLLM0.11.0/Torch2.8.0/Transformers4.57.1 ran BF16 with the automatically selected Flash Attention backend. Both initial jobs failed before generation because the project temporary socket path was too long; shortening only TMPDIR repaired startup. Those failures, the original manifest, and all allocated time are preserved. The runtime-only repair preceded every model output.

#### Stage12U-S — Reasoning-state production versus utilization

Completed 2026-09-30T12:33:22.219114+00:00. **STATE_PRODUCTION_SIGNAL**. Authorized stage ends here; no follow-on launched.

Five frozen B4 C−T+ families are the primary targeted cohort; two B1 families are descriptive. Exactly156 scientific calls comprise84 core transfers,42 question-only controls and30 deterministic cyclic shuffled controls. Every family-condition has three fixed seeds; majority success requires at least2/3. Exact intervals are descriptive. The independent unit is family; this n5 outcome-selected cohort cannot estimate population prevalence or support asymptotic significance claims.

##### Interpretation and controls

Same-model Thinking-prefix sufficiency: **5/5**. Production support: **4/5**; utilization support: **0/5**; repair support: **0/5**. Text-insufficient items: **0/5**.

Source quality is fixed independently of transfer outcomes. Utilization requires no material evidence error and a valid derivation; repair requires flawed evidence and/or derivation. Question-only success weakens trace-specific interpretation. Shuffled success tests whether relevant content, rather than simply a long prefix, matters; all such outcomes above remain part of the interpretation.

Only 0/5 primary CoT prefixes meet the source-quality prerequisite for strong utilization. Thus zero utilization support is not evidence that the checkpoints are equally capable of using an adequate state. Production support establishes useful portability under this transfer assay; it does not certify every intermediate deduction or establish that production is the sole cause of the native advantage.

- Q_I: majority success 0/5 resolved families; 0 missing.
- Q_T: majority success 2/4 resolved families; 1 missing.
- ST_I: majority success 0/5 resolved families; 0 missing.
- SC_T: majority success 0/5 resolved families; 0 missing.

These are checkpoint-specific operating regimes: checkpoint, sampling and output budget differ. No direct hidden-state mechanism or pure Thinking-on/off cause is identified. Failed R_T→T replay does not distinguish omitted multimodal state, early answer-safe cutoff, or stochastic continuation. Historical E*→Instruct failures are preserved single trials, not a newly replicated content-ablation control.

#### Phase12U-S: Externalized reasoning-state production vs utilization

##### Current Objective
Complete the approved image-free reasoning-prefix transfer assay. **COMPLETE / STOP — STATE_PRODUCTION_SIGNAL** (2026-09-30T12:35:46.064019+00:00).

##### Active Constraints
Five frozen primary B4 and two descriptive B1 C−T+ families; unchanged historical source traces and labels; three fixed seeds per condition; original question, native assistant prefill, zero image tokens. Frozen recipes/caps and answer-safe cuts. Target<5/hard7GPUh. No follow-on without user authorization.

##### Current State
- All12 technical and156 scientific calls complete/input-valid. Technical12/12 pass. Scientific152 scoreable; four pre-answer caps remain missing, never wrong.
- First scoring156 and separate-pass same-agent QC44/44 complete. All16 required artifacts, four PNG/PDF figure pairs and156 full-response reading copies produced.
- Frozen source/analysis seals intact; 3113 historical files unchanged.
- Eight GPU jobs completed/released;4.261389 allocatedGPUh. No active user jobs. Zero-GPU observer collected all receipts and exited; its Slurm terminal exit is unavailable after record purge with accounting disabled, but its completion artifact exists.
- Source audits use whole-prefix lexical scans plus targeted semantic/content review, not exhaustive independent review.

##### Evidence That Matters
Primary B4 majority success: R_T→T5/5; R_T→I4/5; R_C→I1/5; R_C→T2/5. Q→I0/5 and both shuffled panels0/5. Q→T2/4 resolved families with one unresolved due two capped seeds. PRODUCTION_SUPPORT4/5 (2975,798,750,2908); UTILIZATION_SUPPORT0/5; REPAIR_SUPPORT0/5; TEXT_NOT_SUFFICIENT0/5. Item991 remains unclassified by strong support predicates. Both secondary B1 families show production support descriptively.

Evidence paths: outputs/stage12us/v1/stage12us_primary_inference.json; stage12us_decision.json; stage12us_summary.md; audit/final_verification.json. Full responses: reports/stage12us/v1/index.md.

##### Failed Attempts and Lessons
No infrastructure failure/retry. Four unfinished caps: Q_T_991_r0/r2 and ST_I_2908_r2/ST_I_2975_r0. Hypothetical or explicitly retracted candidates were not promoted to answers. Shuffled prefixes sometimes induce answers to the source task; emitted values remain scored against the assigned target under frozen rules. Primary conclusions unaffected by missing control majorities.

##### Open Candidates
Useful Thinking text is portable to Instruct on four selected primary families. Which intermediate deductions cause this portability remains unknown. No primary CoT prefix meets the valid-source/valid-derivation prerequisite for strong utilization, so zero utilization support cannot rule out target utilization differences. Source imperfections, targeted n5 cohort, checkpoint/recipe/cap differences and historical single-trial baselines limit claims.

##### Next-Step Decision
- Bottleneck: localization of the useful transferred content; no additional execution authorized.
- Memory: D144 selected the targeted cohort; Stage12U-S now meets frozen production thresholds with Q-only/shuffled controls.
- Chosen action: close this stage and STOP.
- Exactly one recommendation: Localize which Thinking-derived intermediate deductions make the state portable to Instruct using prefix-position and content ablations.
- Rationale: Thinking text enables Instruct success where question-only and shuffled text fail, but content-level causality has not been isolated.

All three frozen main-study phenomenon criteria pass.

##### Primary effects

##### Validity and interpretation limits

- This compares pinned Qwen3-VL-4B variants under their validated native recipes, with preregistered 32,768/81,920 output-token caps. It is neither a causal Thinking-toggle nor an equal-compute comparison.
- E* rescue concerns incomplete demonstrated recovery of task-critical visual evidence. Evidence supply can change accessibility, representation and binding. A post-evidence advantage does not identify its downstream mechanism.
- All unresolved parser/equivalence records, the fixed 10% hash audit, caps and native nonletter-option golds were reviewed by the same agent. This is not independent human reliability evidence. Versioned presentation repairs and second adjudications preserve original outputs, golds and records. Some initial extraction strings remain parser artifacts; semantic grading uses documented terminal-response review.
- Native source/gold defects remain. The frozen absolute numeric tolerance of 1e-6 can reject rounded responses when native gold is exact, even where source wording permits rounding. No outcome-based gold, tolerance, cohort or recipe adjustment was made.
- Conservative aliases and prior source-catalog exposure are disclosed. Unknown dependence may remain. Source strata are secondary and do not replace the primary cohort.

Exactly one recommendation: Review and authorize Stage14C task-selectivity testing, taking the reported seed robustness and source limitations into account; Stage14B does not identify a mechanism.

#### Stage14C — Cross-task evidence-supply bottlenecks

The completed study shows a large retained Thinking advantage under equal textual evidence in the math anchor, with smaller and uncertain gaps on the selected MMStar and BlindTest strata. Oracle evidence rescues many native failures in every panel, but it is not uniformly beneficial: the BlindTest line-intersection representation causes substantially more Instruct regressions than rescues. The bounded evidence probe has material elicitation and granularity limitations, so it cannot convert these behavioral results into a pure perception/reasoning decomposition.

All 4,588 unique new main calls and 600 frozen D1 calls are complete, with zero technical missingness. Main scoring, the primary-only summary, 89 source sensitivities, two-pass review of all D1 outputs, five figures and their provenance are preserved. The 42 scientific G2 calls are included in main, not additional calls; six synthetic replay calls are separately accounted. No new primary math output was generated or regraded.

##### Scope, identities and source coverage

|---|---:|---:|---|
| MATH-Vision anchor | 3,040 / 2,104 | 1,000 | Sealed Stage14B reuse; not an independent new replication |
| MMStar | 1,000 / 1,000 | 280 | 28% eligible; mixed VQA including math; one late source-QC defect disclosed below |
| BlindTest | 714 / 714 | 300 | 42.02% eligible; all E* cases are line intersections, while native covers nine task labels |

The original plan's G0 hold was released by the user's “proceed”; the timestamped approval receipt supersedes the preserved draft status. Source cohorts and E* were frozen before generation, with two-pass same-agent review of all 580 accepted new E* records and a fixed 172-family reread. Source revisions and rejected candidates remain visible. MMStar's 250-family reserve was unused. Direct-answer tasks that could not support an answer-safe E* remain native-only. All 300 line-geometry derivations agree with native golds; this is not independent semantic certification of every benchmark gold.

The pinned Qwen3-VL-4B Instruct/Thinking checkpoints and validated Stage14B recipes are unchanged. E* inputs are image-free with identical evidence content across variants. This compares distinct deployed models and recipes, not equal compute or a same-weights Thinking toggle.

##### Primary results

All intervals below are unadjusted 95% family-bootstrap intervals: 10,000 draws, seed 120220260929, paired family-equal comparisons and independent task streams. No familywise-significance claim is made. Unscorable outputs are never collapsed into wrong answers.

Math has 31 unresolved follow-ups among 449 identified native-wrong Instruct cases: rescue bounds are 52.12–59.02%. MMStar has one among 38: bounds 65.79–68.42%. BlindTest has none. These conditional percentages do not identify the fraction of all benchmark failures caused by a visual misread.

The post-E* paired gaps have missingness bounds of 11.10–18.60 pp (math), 1.07–2.50 pp (MMStar) and 1.33 pp (BlindTest). These are missing-outcome identification bounds, not sampling uncertainty intervals. Marginal scored accuracies are math I 72.15%, T 85.63%; MMStar I 90.22%, T 91.43%; BlindTest I 63.00%, T 64.33%. #### Stage14C bounded D1 evidence-elicitation diagnostic

All 600 frozen calls and 1,200 explicit same-agent source/response reviews are complete. The 100 families per task were selected by the frozen source-only hash before new outcomes. This is a descriptive secondary assay, opened after the primary summary was sealed. No prompt, target, membership or generation recipe was tuned after seeing responses.

Instruct is scored on its committed response; Thinking on the committed body after the last `</think>`. Recall requires the frozen value, source identity, relation and qualifiers. Correct answers alone receive no evidence credit. Exact atom recovery requires all of its source units. Accurate partial observations are retained among accurate unmatched assertions, but do not receive full-unit credit. Source unit maps are identical across variants.

| Task/model | Scored / selected | Full E* recovery | Exact atom recall macro % | Subfact recall macro % | Full recovery bounds over 100 % |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| math/I | 97/100 | 20 | 24.48 | 35.11 | [20.00, 23.00] |
| math/T | 100/100 | 31 | 34.83 | 45.86 | [31.00, 31.00] |
| MMStar/I | 96/100 | 38 | 39.58 | 46.90 | [38.00, 42.00] |
| MMStar/T | 99/100 | 53 | 53.54 | 63.55 | [53.00, 54.00] |
| BlindTest/I | 100/100 | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 | [0.00, 0.00] |
| BlindTest/T | 100/100 | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 | [0.00, 0.00] |

Macro means weight families equally; these are descriptive point estimates, with no confirmatory significance claim. The bounds treat unresolved probes as no/full recovery without changing their recorded status.

| Task/model | Exact atoms / atoms (micro) | Recovered units / units (micro) | Structured-unit recall macro / micro % | Targeted precision macro % (families with assertions) | Targeted precision micro |
|---|---:|---:|---|---|---|
| math/I | 36/140 | 238/779 | 36.22 / 30.53 | 30.53 (93) | 238/663 = 35.90% |
| math/T | 48/143 | 344/804 | 44.21 / 42.52 | 46.29 (99) | 344/589 = 58.40% |
| MMStar/I | 46/118 | 218/605 | 44.03 / 34.62 | 62.02 (77) | 218/409 = 53.30% |
| MMStar/T | 61/121 | 344/631 | 61.43 / 53.68 | 63.93 (98) | 344/471 = 73.04% |
| BlindTest/I | 0/100 | 0/500 | 0.00 / 0.00 | undefined (0) | 0/0 = undefined% |
| BlindTest/T | 0/100 | 0/500 | 0.00 / 0.00 | 0.00 (9) | 0/24 = 0.00% |

Targeted precision is the fraction of asserted direct-image facts matching complete required units. It is not ordinary factual accuracy: accurate irrelevant or partial facts remain in its denominator; derived statements and marked uncertainty are excluded. An empty assertion denominator stays undefined. Conjunction granularity and strict compound-unit matching limit comparability across tasks.

These are associations across separately prompted calls. They do not show what the original native solver internally knew. Full unit recovery is also not equivalent to a sufficient or correct mathematical solution.

##### Validity limits and preserved negative evidence

- BlindTest: 100/100 Instruct committed bodies are bare brace-enclosed answers. Thinking has 91/100 bare answers and nine prose responses. None recovers a complete frozen geometry unit. Eleven correct partial assertions and 13 contradictory assertions remain in the Thinking review records. This is failure of demonstrated recovery under this elicitation/scoring contract, not evidence of zero internal visual knowledge. The unchanged native question includes an answer-only instruction after the evidence-probe instruction; this conflict is a plausible elicitation contributor, not a tested cause. No repair or rerun was performed.
- Six Instruct probes hit the frozen cap (three math, three MMStar) and remain unresolved; no Thinking probe hits its cap. MMStar:997 contributes an additional source-QC unresolved probe for each model, because the frozen plant/horse arrow was reversed. Targets and main results were not rewritten.
- Numerical chart approximations that lack the frozen target precision, counts without spatial locations, and partial object descriptions remain explicit partial observations. Low complete-unit recall cannot by itself establish an acquisition failure.
- Same-agent two-pass review is auditable but does not provide independent inter-rater reliability. Review-pass differences and original judgments remain preserved. Source-only two-pass QC is not infallible.
- No D2/D3, hidden-state probe, source-grounded decoding, lookback intervention or new benchmark was run.

Original: [outputs/blindtest_human_audit/v1/blindtest_review_guide.md](<../outputs/blindtest_human_audit/v1/blindtest_review_guide.md>)  
SHA-256: `f288c622d816e1e9472a053e03284c51bc4841fed5061b8c4faf245b361e054e`

#### BlindTest human case audit

Open **`blindtest_case_viewer.html`** in a modern browser. Keep `assets/`, `cases/`, and `images/` beside it. No server, network connection, model, or GPU is required. If using the ZIP, extract the entire ZIP first; opening the HTML from inside a ZIP preview will not load its case files.

This package contains all **300 frozen Stage14C / Stage14C-V BlindTest line-intersection families**. They are previously outcome-observed cases, **not a new independent confirmation sample**. The package is a read-only view of research records plus a separate form for your future annotations. It does not certify E*, change scores, or revise either stage's estimates.

##### Start with the image

1. The default **image-first view** displays the original source image and exact benchmark question, including its original answer-format instructions. Click the image to enlarge it; choose **100% pixels** for native resolution. Escape closes the enlargement.
2. Solve the problem before selecting **Reveal gold**. Gold resets to hidden on every case. Both the raw gold and its integer-normalized rendering are shown when revealed.
3. Open **evidence and model comparison** when ready to inspect R0/R1/R2, outputs, visual claims and source construction. This may reveal the answer even if gold remains hidden.
4. Record your own judgments. Blank means **unreviewed**, not uncertain, no, or unknown. All subjective fields in the delivered CSV are empty.
5. Use Previous/Next or Left/Right arrow keys when focus is outside a form/control. ID search also finds representative and alias item IDs. Every queue has a fixed hash order.

Original filenames encode gold (`gt_...`). Packaged images use opaque family hashes. The viewer hides original filenames and gold-bearing metadata until Reveal gold. Opening original provenance files, the index CSV, or the manifest can reveal gold. This is a practical image-first interface, not a secure blinding system.

##### What the records mean

**Native image — Stage14C:** the original image plus exact author question. The saved input receipt includes the serialized chat template, image reference/hash and preprocessing parameters, user messages, seed, and sampling settings. The viewer preserves the original image bytes; it never draws a substitute image.

**Historical E* — Stage14C:** the original equal-evidence call. This is shown as its own row, not folded into R0. Historical Instruct native-correct → E*-wrong regressions number **104**.

**Fresh R0 — Stage14C-V:** the fresh call using the original E* serialization. The prompt is byte-identical to historical E* for these cases, but the generations and receipts are separate. Fresh Instruct native-correct → R0-wrong regressions number **103**. This package retains that distinction everywhere.

**R1 / R2 — Stage14C-V:** typed structured fields / entity-explicit prose. Text is sliced directly from the saved supplied prompts, not regenerated from a current renderer. The side-by-side display preserves every character. Amber highlighting is a token/whitespace-preserving **lexical** diff from R0; it does not judge semantic equivalence. Full Instruct and Thinking user/chat prompts are separately expandable for every condition.

**Raw generation:** exact `raw_decoded_response` from the immutable `generation.json`. It may contain tentative or retracted reasoning, repetition, and incomplete output. Nothing is suppressed based on correctness. A full trace remains accessible even when the response is unscorable.

**Raw final quote:** the literal text at an existing original parser span, when one exists. It is distinct from the parser's answer value. If the original parser had no saved span, the viewer says so rather than inventing a final quote. Use the full raw output and any existing semantic review in that case.

**Parser answer:** the saved original extraction, before a response review. **Reviewed answer:** a saved separate response review, if present; otherwise “No separate response review.” **Scored answer/status:** the existing final correctness record. The index preserves all three answer fields. No new answer extraction, adjudication or scoring is performed.

**Reasoning trace:** the exact prefix before the final `</think>` delimiter where present. The opening `<think>` may be in the input chat template. If there is no explicit delimiter, the viewer does not manufacture a reasoning/final split. Expand the complete Instruct raw output to see any prose it generated. All 1,500 Thinking native/historical-E/R generations have their delimited traces, as do the 100 Thinking D1 probes.

##### Visual claims: four different provenance types

- **Native self-generated text:** exact excerpts from native raw outputs. The excerpt index is a deterministic sentence/line-like lexical search for blue, red, intersection/crossing/touching, vertex, line, or segment words. It is navigation assistance, **not a new set of evidence labels**. An excerpt can be a hypothesis, derivation, retraction, paraphrase of the task, or factual assertion. Character ranges are zero-based, end-exclusive Unicode code-point offsets in the saved `raw_decoded_response`; line numbers are one-based. Full raw text is authoritative.
- **D1 separately elicited evidence:** 100 families × two models. D1 used a different prompt asking for visible facts. Its complete inputs, raw reasoning/response, and existing two-pass source-claim reviews are preserved. Existing `contradictory` classifications, exact quotes and reviewer source bindings are displayed alongside the researcher E* and original image. They are historical same-agent assessments, not new human verification. D1 is not evidence that the native solver used those statements.
- **Researcher-provided oracle E*:** the R descriptions, underlying ledger and source-QC history. These are precisely what you are auditing, not privileged truth.
- **Inferred/reconstructed wrong claims:** none created. A wrong final answer cannot be reverse-engineered into a visual premise.

No exhaustive existing native-claim truth adjudication was recovered. Thus native “wrong visual fact” remains **NOT OBSERVED / UNKNOWN** pending your inspection, even when the lexical index contains suspicious text. This means no adjudicated wrong-fact record is available; it does not assert that the raw generation has no wrong fact. Missing D1 probes for the other 200 families are explicit.

The existing D1 review inventory contains 13 `contradictory`, 11 `accurate_irrelevant`, and 1 `derived` claim across nine families. Only the existing `contradictory` label is presented as a prior wrong-claim assessment. Each has exact quote locations and its saved reviewer binding. Corresponding E* remains researcher-provided evidence subject to this audit.

##### Source geometry and the checker limitation

All 300 cases have saved **image-derived pixel y samples** for the red and blue paths at approximately 1%, 50%, and 99% image width. The samples come from `stage14c/audit/line_pixel_order_qc_v2.json`; the sampling code is linked. Coordinates use a top-left image origin.

The viewer independently repeats only the arithmetic on those existing samples: count sign changes of `blue_y - red_y` between adjacent positions. The calculation does not use gold or model answers. It is shown separately from original gold and assumes two straight-segment paths sharing their three horizontal vertex positions, plus correct endpoint/bend sampling.

**This is not an independent geometric ground-truth checker.** The saved values are approximate pixel samples used in the prior annotation pipeline, not the original generator's six vertex coordinates. The official generator export saves unsigned distances, image parameters and gold, without the per-instance vertices; its preserved source code is linked. We do not reconstruct missing vertices, re-read pixels to label cases, or replace gold. Agreement of the conditional calculation with gold does not prove source fidelity, task sufficiency or answer safety.

Some nested historical records retain labels such as `NOT_REVIEWED` or `G0_PROPOSAL_NOT_G1_QC_SEAL`. They are displayed unchanged as provenance from an earlier point in the pipeline. The final eligibility record and G1 seal are separately linked; no historical field is silently rewritten.

##### Review queues and deterministic ordering

Order is ascending SHA256 of:

```
blindtest-human-audit-v1-20261010|<family_id>
```

The same order applies within every filter. “Either model” takes the union across models and counts each family once. Queues overlap and are not independent samples. The R transition queues use **fresh Stage14C-V R0**, never historical E*. Wrong requires the saved `WRONG` label; unscorable responses are not relabeled wrong.

| Queue | Either model | Instruct | Thinking |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Native correct → R0 wrong → R2 correct | 107 | 56 | 56 |
| Native correct → R0/R1/R2 wrong | 6 | 3 | 3 |
| Native correct → R1 wrong, with R0 or R2 correct | 171 | 142 | 77 |
| Native wrong → R0/R1/R2 correct | 38 | 11 | 27 |
| Unscorable / incomplete / extraction revised | 23 | 6 | 17 |

Additional queues:

- **Instruct / Thinking disagree: 272.** At least one of native/R0/R1/R2 differs in saved status or final scored answer. For comparison only, braces and whitespace are removed from saved answer strings; correctness labels stay unchanged.
- **All conditions and both models agree: 2.** All eight native/R0/R1/R2 cells agree in answer and status. This strict control definition excludes historical E*. There are only two such families, so the “up to 12” hash-selected control queue includes both, without relaxing the rule.
- **E* / geometry / leakage considerations: 300.** Every family lacks the full original generator coordinates and uses a relation-based textual reduction. This is a broad invitation to audit, **not 300 verified source errors or leakage cases**.
- **Historical pixel QC changed prior order: 0** in the saved v2 record's `prior_orders` versus `orders`. This does not certify all earlier annotation history.
- **Existing contradictory D1 claim: 9.** Membership comes only from the existing pass-2 records and is independent of the selected native-model filter.

The output-issue queue includes any unscorable/technical-missing saved status, cap or saved repetition flag, or an existing response-review answer differing from its original parser value. A review difference is not automatically a scoring error. There are two unscorable fresh R2 Instruct outputs; the other included cases can be fully scored after prior adjudication.

Suggested order: inspect the two strict agreement controls, then all-format regressions, R0-to-R2 reversals, R1-specific regressions, all-format rescues, disagreements and output issues. Stay in hash order within each queue. Review E* quality before interpreting the model transitions, and inspect the original image before the supplied evidence. This order is navigation guidance, not case selection for a new analysis.

##### Your annotations

The delivered template has 300 identity rows and nine empty judgment fields:

- `image_gold_correct`, `E_star_source_faithful`, `E_star_task_sufficient`, `E_star_answer_leakage`, `R0_R1_R2_semantically_equivalent`: yes / no / uncertain.
- `native_wrong_visual_fact_observed`, `model_evidence_misread`: yes / no / unknown.
- `apparent_reason_for_failure`: visual misread / textual representation issue / downstream reasoning / scoring issue / unclear.
- `reviewer_notes`: free text. Specify the model/condition, exact claim and image location when useful.

The browser saves annotations only in its own local storage. **Export CSV and back up JSON regularly.** Browser file-origin storage behavior varies; if storage is unavailable, a visible warning explains that entries are in memory only. Restoring a JSON backup asks before replacing matching local entries. It never writes research artifacts. The CSV escapes quotes/newlines and prefixes spreadsheet formula-like values with an apostrophe; JSON retains exact note strings. Browser-test annotations were confined to disposable test profiles and are not present in the delivered template or data.

##### Files and provenance

- `blindtest_case_viewer.html`, `assets/`, `cases/`, `images/`: fully offline viewer and exact exported content.
- `blindtest_case_manifest.json`: all 300 identities, source mappings/image hashes, exact R evidence/prompts, model revisions, per-call stage/condition/replicate/seed, answer/status fields, source paths and SHA256 hashes.
- `blindtest_case_index.csv`: compact 300-row answer/status/transition index. Contains gold.
- `blindtest_review_template.csv`: all identity rows, no subjective judgments.
- `blindtest_audit_summary.md`: availability and preservation summary.
- `validation/data_validation.json`, `availability_counts.json`, `browser_validation.json`: validation evidence.
- `validation/consumed_artifact_hashes.json`: hashes of every consumed research artifact, checked unchanged after export.
- `build_package.py`: deterministic read-only exporter. It is an audit utility, not an inference or scoring runner.

Every model record links its original input, generation, result receipt, task manifest, parser extraction, response review if any, and final score. Exact scoring/adjudication versions are identified by those artifact paths and hashes plus the linked stage scoring seals, rather than a guessed uniform version number. Canonical completed attempts are used; incomplete attempts and Stage14C-V context-recovery replays are not merged into primary outcomes. Raw token arrays remain in their original generation artifacts; all requested raw text is copied into the portable case files.

Original artifact links resolve in the original repository layout. If this folder is moved to a different computer, those links may be unavailable; paths and hashes remain visible, while the copied images, exact prompts, raw text, scores, reviews and source annotations work offline. Keep the whole extracted package together.

No new model calls, GPU work, source labels, score changes, benchmark repair, or follow-on experiment was performed.

#### Stage14D-0 native trace audit — completed

Completed 2026-10-11T22:31:25.975640+00:00. Scope: approved v 2 retrospective audit, original E* versus Instruct-native versus Thinking-native. **No new inference or GPU use.** Old Stage14D: 1,674 continuations/375 GPU-hours remain HOLD; Stage14C-V closure unchanged. The bounded D1 proposal is a document only.

The audit supports an evidence-state verification problem that includes source binding, global structure and downstream use. It does **not** establish that Thinking causally perceives better or that reacquisition alone explains E* rescue. In the source-selected panel, the paired Thinking–Instruct error contrast among mutually explicit facts is **-3.60 pp [-7.86, +0.40] (n=131)**. The interval includes zero. The recommended future action is a small verification-and-use feasibility study, not the old exhaustive continuation grid.

##### Coverage, provenance and review limitations

All **300 frozen family IDs / 300 images / 600 native r0 outputs** were reviewed, paired for every family. There are **437 historical E* parents and 1,887 source-defined subfacts**, producing 3,774 model/subfact rows. **1,883 subfacts are source-adjudicable**; four subfacts in three families are withheld. Both native finals are scoreable for 246 families; raw outputs are available even when finals are unscorable. Native I: 119 correct/128 wrong/53 unscorable; T: 143 correct/156 wrong/1 unscorable. These pooled discovery-cohort counts are not prevalence estimates.

The audited 300 overlap 190 of the old 300 source reviews and 71 I+186 T=257 of the old 414 target-focused native reviews. All 600 native strings were assessed for this broader source-atom audit; the old 414 are not an additional cohort. The inventory joins all 1,000 eligible families, 2,000 native raws and 4,000 score records. Exact seed, input, model/processor/template, raw hash, scorer receipt and answer status remain in the [inventory](<../outputs/stage14d0/inventory/source_and_raw_output_manifest.jsonl>). No E*-conditioned reasoning was opened; those arms contribute archived score metadata only.

**One main AI reviewer, zero independent human reviewers.** Semantic decisions were manually authored by this agent; deterministic programs validated spans and summarized records. No inter-reviewer agreement statistic is estimable. Source/E*/scores/other-arm displays were masked during Pass A, but prior exposure, trace-style model identification and same-agent memory prevent independent blinding. Exact source before/after display ordering is best-effort; persistence exceptions 2961 T, 2006,2714,2390 and 1841 T's final 732 characters are disclosed in the limitations ledger. They are not relabelled as pristine blinded review. A later source check corrected the Pass A suspicion that 2547's 1/3/9 labels were invented: those labels are printed.

Full native text coverage totals 24,514,716 Unicode characters. For repetitive cap tails, lossless paragraph/RLE receipts preserve all unique text, original order and exact reconstruction; no semantic truncation or keyword-only review. There are 2,061 selected claim excerpts, **not an exhaustive count of all repeated utterances**. Closure verified 2,945 exact quoted spans. Character offsets are authoritative; generated-token offsets are unfilled rather than fabricated by retokenization. Many excerpts cover several facts. Precise first-use, first-revision or first-divergence timing is not available for every row.

##### Model and text boundaries

The archived models are Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct revision`ebb281ec70b05090aa6165b016eac8ec08e71b17` and Qwen3-VL-4B-Thinking revision`1de27d8c51f12e819435303b9e84c4e25ba8401e`. Historical vLLM/BF16 execution is unchanged. I sampling: temperature 0.7/top-p 0.8/top-k 20/repetition 1/presence 1.5/cap 32,768; T: temperature 1/top-p 0.95/top-k 20/repetition 1/presence 0/cap 81,920. Per-family recorded seeds and runtime inputs are preserved.

Instruct's generated explanation is observable text, not an authenticated internal reasoning trace. Thinking's pre-`</think>` text is also a generated trace, not proof of a hidden computation or image retrieval. Both complete strings, including final exposition, were read. The primary last-state audit covers the whole output; it is **not a uniformly isolated pre-answer-only contrast**. Exact Thinking tag boundaries and manually quoted I answer regions are retained; capped uncommitted responses have no invented final boundary. A pre-answer-anchor sensitivity excludes rows with only final-exposition anchors, but cannot turn sparse excerpts into exhaustive pre-answer coding.

Median generated lengths: I 5,043 tokens (IQR 1,901–11,155.75), T 13,322.5 (6,925.25–22,591.75). Different checkpoints, recipes, caps and opportunities to verbalize facts confound a causal “Thinking” comparison. [Length/mention-opportunity strata](<../outputs/stage14d0/analysis/length_and_mention_opportunity.csv>) report this without claiming equal compute. A missing statement is never called absent acquisition.

##### Sampling and uncertainty

R contains 150 families selected by frozen source metadata strata from the 1,000 eligible frame; F contains 150 additional outcome-enriched families, including the 32 pilot cases where selected. Selection files preserve exact IDs, seed`stage14d0-v2-20261012`, hashes, quotas, inclusion probabilities and inverse-probability weights. R is retrospective and source-eligible-cohort conditional; it is not all MathVision or a new unobserved confirmation sample. F is discovery-only, never pooled as unweighted prevalence. The geometry-equivalent 751/1744 pair remains under its frozen IDs, with a merged-cluster sensitivity (299 clusters in the combined diagnostic).

Intervals use 4,000 paired family-cluster bootstrap draws, seed 20261012. R resamples within source strata and uses design weights; F gives families equal weight. Within-family fact rates prevent a large grid from acting as dozens of independent families. Intervals measure sampling variability, **not annotation error**. Tables/figures also show nested raw counts; nonexclusive evidence-type totals must not be added. No multiplicity-adjusted confirmatory claim is made.

##### A. Evidence types and missingness

| Model, R | Required-fact explicit-correct coverage | Incorrect among explicitly correct/wrong facts | Families with ≥1 last explicit error |
|---|---|---|---|
| I | 55.85% [49.96, 61.70] (n=150 families) | 28.92% [23.60, 34.76] (n=140 families) | 49.91% [41.99, 57.87] (n=150 families) |
| T | 58.37% [52.12, 64.45] (n=150 families) | 26.85% [21.44, 32.44] (n=140 families) | 43.92% [36.04, 51.83] (n=150 families) |

R's family-weighted not-stated fractions are 4.51%I/3.59%T; vague/unmatchable 19.97%I/21.63%T. These are separate from incorrect claims. Raw R type counts include structured-layout errors 67/155 I and 47/137 T explicit subfacts; entity-binding 54/230 I and 52/223 T; topology 38/113 I and 38/108 T. Visual-convention 32/57 T versus 13/33 I shows that errors are not uniformly reduced in T. These are overlapping, nested descriptive type counts, not independently significant differences.

[Table A](<../outputs/stage14d0/analysis/evidence_type_by_model.csv>) carries parent/subfact/family and explicit-opportunity denominators, missingness and use states. [Figure1](<../outputs/stage14d0/figures/figure1_evidence_taxonomy.png>). Unsupported/nonrequired observations remain separate in the [verbatim supplemental ledger](<../outputs/stage14d0/analysis/nonrequired_claims_and_downstream_observations.csv>), rather than being silently added to the required E* denominator.

##### B. Same-family, same-fact comparison

Of 1,887 paired subfacts: 739 both explicitly correct, 98 I-only wrong, 59 T-only wrong, 106 both wrong in the same way, 91 both wrong differently, 19 both wrong but identity unresolved, 203 one/both not stated, 568 ambiguous/unmatchable and 4 source-uncertain. The restricted both-explicit denominator is 1,112 subfacts, nested within 258 families across R/F. Wrong identity was compared manually from source bindings and actual statements; neither wrong final answers nor quote similarity supplied the labels.

The R paired error contrast is **-3.60 pp [-7.86, +0.40] (n=131)**; F **-2.45 pp [-7.09, +2.12] (n=127)**. R correct-required-coverage difference is **+2.51 pp [-1.91, +7.08] (n=150)**. F's coverage gain is **+6.98 pp [+2.70, +11.48] (n=150)**, but that panel is outcome-enriched. These are compatible with modest differences and substantial uncertainty, not a clean perception advantage.

Source-QC exclusion, both-scoreable, strict direct-visual, parent structure, first/last/used states, vague-as-error upper bound, pre-answer anchors and duplicate clusters are saved in [all bootstrap results](<../outputs/stage14d0/analysis/cluster_bootstrap_and_sensitivity.json>). R's strict-direct-visual paired error contrast is **-1.67 pp [-6.35, +3.37] (n=79)**. [Figure2](<../outputs/stage14d0/figures/figure2_paired_error_matrix.png>).

Examples: 2507 both ultimately fold Y above V instead of W despite I's intervening correct description; 2702 both insert checkerboard white cells into entirely dark rows; 2851 adopt different wrong grid sizes and coordinates. Shared errors and different errors both occur. None proves a common latent source or a causal visual-access mechanism.

##### C. Observable propagation

The source-valid ledger contains 444 I/434 T subfacts with some explicitly wrong history. An incorrect premise is recorded as used for 389 I/391 T subfacts; these use counts also include assumptions whose source claim remains ambiguous and are **not a subset ratio of ever-wrong assertions**. Forty-one I and 86 T subfacts have a wrong-use plus later-revision record, not necessarily a successful repair. Sixty-four I/57 T ever-wrong facts lack observed wrong use; “claim only” means use unobserved, not proven absent.

First-use offsets are missing for 1,735 I/1,739 T of 1,883 valid subfacts. Many positive use judgments are qualitative, supported by arithmetic/geometry snippets but without a certified earliest time. The table's earliest wrong snippet is an **earliest annotated text event**, not a certified first internal error. Do not estimate an acquisition-to-integration latency from these sparse timestamps. [Timeline table](<../outputs/stage14d0/analysis/first_error_and_propagation.csv>), [event ledger](<../outputs/stage14d0/annotations/event_chronology_and_self_correction.jsonl>), [Figure3](<../outputs/stage14d0/figures/figure3_observable_propagation.png>).

##### D. Self-revision with the right denominator

Among initially explicit wrong facts, I has 378 opportunities and T 262. Seventeen I and 9 T have a recorded wrong→source-consistent correction with ordered span anchors; 15 I/9 T are recorded as subsequently used, 2 I as not used. Three further T correction candidates lack a sufficient ordered span pair and remain unconfirmed in this count. These are conservative **annotation counts**, not independently validated rates of true visual retrieval. Partial correction and correct→wrong→correct instability are not forced into a successful-correction label.

Family-weighted R correction fractions are I 9.39% [3.74, 16.23] (n=80 families) and T 7.60% [1.52, 15.18] (n=66 families). The raw 17/378 versus 9/262 and these family-equal estimates answer different aggregation questions. No claim of higher Thinking visual self-correction is warranted. “Look again” language does not verify new image access. [Denominator table](<../outputs/stage14d0/analysis/self_correction_initial_error_denominators.csv>), [Figure4](<../outputs/stage14d0/figures/figure4_self_correction.png>).

##### E. Correct stated reference facts do not ensure a correct solution

Fifteen I and 20 T wrong native finals have all required source-valid E* subfacts last stated correctly. This is a full-required-reference coverage flag, **not automatic proof of a purely downstream error**, because E* can be minimal and other native source claims can still be wrong.

- **1118 T: ** the tile's four triangular sectors are explicitly correct. The trace later swaps row/column adjacency, verifies inconsistent constructions and lists 5+5+2+2 light border triangles while claiming 12. This is concrete downstream construction/use evidence; repeated source restatement alone would not fix it.
- **2078 I: ** cube vertex identities are source-consistent, then the cut-solid construction invents edgeEGand miscomputes the volume. Correct initial binding does not prevent later geometric state corruption.
- **2045 T: ** source geometry is eventually restated correctly, but formulas and an absolute-value repair do not produce a valid derivation. A source correction is not equivalent to a corrected answer.
- **2239 T: ** minimal E* steps 1→2 right and 2→3 down are correct, but the cropped spiral's displayed row is misbound to full-grid row 2. This is a counterexample to diagnosing every all-required-correct failure as arithmetic-only.

These examples have exact native/source links in the [viewer](<../outputs/stage14d0/viewer/index.html>), Pass A/B files and [E table](<../outputs/stage14d0/analysis/correct_evidence_wrong_reasoning.csv>). They motivate premise-use verification and retention of incomplete/uncertain classifications. No absent statement or wrong final answer was reverse-engineered into an invented visual error.

##### F. Association with archived textual E* outcomes

Among source-QC-passed R native-wrong families, a last explicit source error appears in 37/43 I rescued cases versus 15/28 I unrescued; T 41/53 rescued versus 8/15 unrescued. Regressions have 1/6 Iand 2/4 Tsuch errors. F differs: 20/25 versus 15/24 I; 27/40 versus 22/45 T. These raw conditional counts are descriptive and sparse, particularly regressions; weighted family intervals and all missing/scoreability strata are retained. [Table F](<../outputs/stage14d0/analysis/error_by_Estar_rescue_outcome.csv>), [Figure5](<../outputs/stage14d0/figures/figure5_errors_and_Estar_outcome.png>).

E* supply changes the input interface, representation, binding and reasoning context. Association with rescue cannot identify mediation or a percentage of pure acquisition failures. Original Stage14B/14C/14C-Vheadline scores and adjudications remain untouched.

##### Source validity and conclusion boundary

Families 604,2869 and 276 have four withheld reference subfacts: an occlusion relation, incomplete dot occupancy, and a supplied numeral where the source has a question mark. Original references remain immutable. Some remaining references make structure explicit or expose task-relevant counts; source faithfulness is not a proof of answer-safety or unchanged task difficulty. No human source-validation reliability was established here.

The audit is complete as a **single-AI retrospective, human-checkable analysis**, with important semantic and timing uncertainty. It supports a future design that identifies the needed entity/structure, verifies it against full/local image context and checks incorporation into subsequent reasoning. It does not validate a decoder, certify fresh acquisition, or establish a causal advantage of one checkpoint/recipe.

**One recommendation: ** the [bounded Stage14D-1 verification-and-use feasibility study](<../outputs/stage14d0/reports/stage14d1_bounded_feasibility_proposal.md>), requiring a separate release. **STOP. No follow-on experiment launched.**

#### Stage14D-0 decision and unresolved limitations

**COMPLETE / STOP.** All six authorized audit phases are complete. No model inference, GPU allocation, LLM judge, external annotator, new dataset, or E*-conditioned reasoning read was used. The old Stage14D 1,674 continuations and 375 GPU-hour proposal remain on hold. This audit does not close Stage14C-V.

##### What the evidence changes

The paired source-selected estimate does not establish a Thinking advantage in explicitly stated source-fact fidelity: T−I error rate −3.60 percentage points, 95% family-bootstrap interval [−7.86, +0.40], 131 eligible paired families. The audit finds entity-binding and structural errors in both models, alongside correct facts that do not lead to a valid solution. It therefore supports testing evidence verification and subsequent premise use together. It does not justify an acquisition-only explanation or the old exhaustive continuation grid.

Exactly one recommendation is documented in the [bounded D1 proposal](<../outputs/stage14d0/reports/stage14d1_bounded_feasibility_proposal.md>). That study has not been launched. There is no additional autonomous action after this report.

##### Reliability and chronology

- One main AI reviewer authored semantic source/trace judgments. There were zero independent human reviewers and no second independent semantic rating. Agreement and human reliability are unavailable. Automated span, join and arithmetic checks do not validate semantic judgments.
- Display masking is not independent blinding. Earlier project work, recognizable trace style and same-agent memory may reveal model identity, source facts or outcomes. The original annotation filename `passA_native_claims_blinded.jsonl` is inherited from the plan; it must not be read as an independence certificate.
- Source-before-persistence exceptions concern 2961 T, 2006, 2714 and 2390. The last 732 characters of 1841 T were read and saved in the same execution step. No pristine blinded sequence is claimed for these records. Source inspection corrected the initial Pass A suspicion about printed labels 1, 3 and 9 in 2547; the original note remains preserved.
- All native strings were reviewed, using lossless repeated-paragraph reconstruction for some cap tails. The 2,061 selected excerpts are not an exhaustive utterance inventory. Broad excerpts can contain several source facts and derived statements.
- Unicode character offsets and quoted text are authoritative. Token offsets are missing. First-use offsets are absent for 1,735 I and 1,739 T subfacts out of 1,883 valid references. A qualitative use judgment does not certify the earliest use. Missing events are unobserved, not time zero.
- Three Thinking correction candidates lack an ordered explicit before/after span pair and are excluded from the anchored correction count. Even anchored correction is text-visible revision, not independently verified visual reacquisition.
- Primary states summarize the last observable assertion in the whole response, including final exposition. Thinking tag boundaries are exact; Instruct answer regions are less uniform and capped uncommitted responses have no invented final boundary. The pre-answer-anchor sensitivity is not an exhaustive reannotation of all pre-answer text.

##### Reference and sampling limitations

- Source-reference problems in 604, 2869 and 276 withhold four subfacts from model correctness denominators. These are separate D0 annotations; historical E*, source files, scores and headline results remain unchanged. See the [closure QC ledger](<../outputs/stage14d0/inventory/source_QC_and_Estar_version_ledger_closure_v1.jsonl>).
- Source-faithful text can expose a structure or task-relevant count more explicitly than the image. It does not establish answer-safety, task equivalence, or absence of a representation effect. Minimal E* need not exhaust relevant visual truth.
- R comprises 150 source-stratified families from the 1,000 eligible frame, with documented inclusion weights. Its interpretation is restricted to that eligible frame. F comprises 150 outcome-enriched discovery families. Pooled counts are not population prevalence.
- Families 751 and 1744 have geometry-equivalent source content. Their frozen IDs remain intact; a merged-cluster sensitivity is supplied. Do not claim 300 independently distinct geometries.
- Required parents, subfacts, selected claim spans and families are different units. Evidence types overlap. Intervals cluster by family and do not account for semantic annotation error.
- Source-QC-valid references can still have ambiguous native matches. NOT_STATED and VAGUE_OR_UNMATCHABLE are neither incorrect evidence nor absent internal knowledge. Nineteen paired both-wrong subfacts have unresolved wrong-identity comparisons.

##### Interpretation bounds

Different checkpoints, sampling recipes, caps and trace lengths prevent a causal equal-compute attribution to Thinking. A correct assertion may be inferred rather than visually retrieved. E* rescue is an association with a changed input representation, not mediation. The 15 I and 20 T native-wrong cases with all required facts last stated correctly are coverage flags, not automatically pure downstream failures. Other visual claims can still be wrong.

The audit is a completed, retrospective, single-AI analysis made inspectable through original images, full native traces and exact annotation provenance. Strong mechanistic claims require independent source/semantic checking and a separately authorized causal experiment.

**STOP — no follow-on experiment executed.**

#### Stage14D-0 supplement: native answer × observable visual evidence

Completed from sealed annotations only. **No inference, GPU work, reannotation, source repair or historical score change.** I = Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct; T = Qwen3-VL-4B-Thinking. The existing audit is preserved.

##### Definitions and denominator

The primary status uses each required **source-valid subfact's last recorded claim state across the whole native output**:

1. **All correct:** every required source-valid subfact is explicitly STATED_CORRECT.
2. **Explicit error:** at least one required source-valid subfact is STATED_INCORRECT or MISBOUND; this takes precedence over incomplete coverage elsewhere.
3. **Incomplete/ambiguous:** no qualifying explicit error, but not all required facts are explicitly correct. Unmentioned, vague, unstable and other unresolved statements are retained here. This is **not an acquisition-failure label**.

Earlier errors that were corrected do not force category 2 in the primary last-state table. An ever-error sensitivity is supplied separately. Four source-invalid subfacts in 276, 604 and 2869 remain withheld; their families remain, using their nonempty source-valid references. All 300 families have both native outputs. Each model has its own CORRECT/WRONG denominator; UNSCORABLE is excluded from primary rates and association estimates, never converted to WRONG.

Cells below are **exact n (unweighted row %)**, conditional on the native answer status. Percentages can differ slightly from 100 after rounding. The panels remain separate: R is source-selected from the 1,000-family E*-eligible frame; F is outcome-enriched; combined tables are descriptive only.

##### Main observations

In the source-selected R panel, explicit last-state evidence errors occur in 52/73 wrong Instruct answers and 50/69 wrong Thinking answers, but also in 13/63 and 15/80 correct answers. Observable source errors are strongly associated with wrong answers without being necessary or sufficient for them.

Conversely, all required source-valid facts are explicitly correct in 9/73 wrong Instruct answers and 5/69 wrong Thinking answers in R; the descriptive combined counts are 15/128 and 20/156. This is not automatically a diagnosis of purely downstream error because the required reference is minimal and other visual claims can be wrong.

R weighted accuracy is 80.8% versus 19.9% for Instruct and 90.8% versus 23.0% for Thinking, comparing all-correct with explicit-error evidence. The corresponding accuracy differences are +60.9 pp [45.7, 75.4] and +67.9 pp [55.5, 80.1]. These are within-model associations; they do not isolate a causal effect of evidence or a Thinking advantage.
